role: SwiftUI Sleep detail screen (pushed from Dashboard sleep card and MorningResultsView sleep card): sleep-score ring hero, quick stats, vitals row, sleep window + Adjust, interactive hypnogram, plus the sections declared in SleepDetailV2View+Breakdown.swift; hosts the SleepTimelineEditorView sheet and a detached 15-night trend computation.
types: SleepDetailV2View: struct (View) — sleep detail screen; inputs session, sleepData, recoveryVitals, recentSessions, temperatureUnit, typicalSleepHours, userAge, onRefresh, onAdjust
SleepDetailV2View.SleepStageKind: enum — stable stage key (deep/rem/light/awake) for stage-pill toggling and explanation dispatch
SleepDetailV2View.SleepDataIdentified: struct (Identifiable) — UUID wrapper so SleepData can drive .sheet(item:)
state: mem:SleepDetailV2View.expandedStage (@State SleepStageKind?, internal so the Breakdown extension can toggle it)
mem:SleepDetailV2View.refreshedVitals (@State RecoveryVitals?, HealthKit re-fetch on appear)
mem:SleepDetailV2View.sleepAnalysis (let SleepScienceAnalyzer.SleepAnalysis?, computed once in init)
mem:SleepDetailV2View.sleepScore (private let Double, computed once in init)
toplevel: Declares ten @ScaledMetric font sizes bound to text styles (20-29), the stored inputs (session, sleepData, recoveryVitals, recentSessions, temperatureUnit, typicalSleepHours, userAge, optional onAdjust closure), the sleepAnalysis/sleepScore lets set by the explicit init, @Environment(RRCollector) and the @State properties. SleepDataIdentified.id is a fresh UUID() per wrapper. No #if blocks.

units.does: Returns the localized display label (Deep/REM/Light/Awake) for a SleepStageKind from LanguageManager.appBundle.

Stores the inputs (onAdjust defaults to nil) and runs SleepScienceAnalyzer.analyze once for sleepData, keeping the analysis in sleepAnalysis and the score in sleepScore (the analysis's enhancedScore, else calculateSleepScore's zero-minute score, else 0), so body evaluations (each hypnogram scrub tick) do not re-run the analyzer.
units.entry: Constructed by DashboardV2View.sleepDetail(for:), MorningResultsView.sleepDetailDestination and DetailScreenSnapshotTests.

units.does: Merges the passed-in recoveryVitals (stored) with the HealthKit-refreshed refreshedVitals field by field (fresh wins for resp/SpO2/temp), and sets restingHeartRate to the session strap analysis meanHR, else stored RHR, else fresh RHR. With neither stored nor fresh returns a heart-rate-only vitals or nil.

branches.cond: strap meanHR nil / stored RHR nil
branches.effect: mergedRHR = strap meanHR, else stored.restingHeartRate, else fresh.restingHeartRate, else nil
returns heartRateOnlyVitals(mergedRHR) (nil when no strap HR); otherwise builds merged RecoveryVitals
falls back to stored respiratoryRate (may be nil)
falls back to stored SpO2 min
falls back to stored wrist temperature
falls back to stored temperature baseline

flags.text: Same merge as VitalsDetailV2View.effectiveVitals (fresh-first for every field, strap > stored > fresh for RHR); two copies of the rule.

units.does: Wraps a strap/stored RHR into a RecoveryVitals with every other field nil; returns nil when mergedRHR is nil.
Wraps sleepScore in a ScoreVerdict (word/colour ladder).
SwiftUI body: wraps sleepStack in withSleepEditor (editor sheet + trend task).
Builds the ScrollView of sleepCards with background, localized "Sleep" title, toolbar menu button, and a .task keyed on session.id that calls refreshVitals.
units.entry: Rendered from body; .task(id: session.id) runs refreshVitals on appear and whenever session.id changes

units.does: Stacks hero, quick stats, vitals, sleep window, hypnogram, stage breakdown, score breakdown, insights, trends, structure and age-group cards in a VStack.

Attaches the SleepTimelineEditorView sheet bound to editorSleepData and a .task keyed on trendInputsKey that runs buildTrend over trendSessions on a detached userInitiated task and stores the result in trendNights unless the keyed task was cancelled meanwhile (a newer key's result is not overwritten).
units.entry: .sheet(item:) presents when editorSleepData is set; .task(id: trendInputsKey) runs on appear and on key change

branches.effect: drops the result; else assigns trendNights

units.does: recentSessions, with the viewed session prepended when the list does not contain it (the morning results list holds only earlier nights).
units.entry: Read by withSleepEditor's trend task and trendInputsKey.

units.does: Builds SleepTimelineEditorView for the wrapped SleepData; onSave calls the onAdjust closure and clears editorSleepData; onRefreshFromHealthKit re-fetches this session's recording window through refetchSleep (nil when the collector is gone or the fetch fails); onRefreshAccepted (Done after a refresh with no further edit) stores the refreshed night through collector.updateSessionSleepBoundaries with isUserAdjustment false, so it doesn't lock the boundaries, and closes the editor.
calls: closure:onAdjust — set by DashboardV2View.sleepDetail (saveSleepBoundaries → collector.updateSessionSleepBoundaries) or MorningResultsView.sleepDetailDestination (vm.healthKitSleep + onAdjustSleep)
writes: archive:session sleep snapshot/boundaries (via updateSessionSleepBoundaries, not a user adjustment)

branches.effect: returns nil to the editor; else refetchSleep

flags.text: docs/FLOWCHART.md says SleepDetailV2View presents SleepTimelineEditorView(session, sleepData) and that Done calls collector.updateSessionSleepBoundaries; the editor takes sleepData/onSave/onRefreshFromHealthKit only and saving goes through the caller's onAdjust, which from MorningResultsView sets vm.healthKitSleep and calls the optional onAdjustSleep instead.

units.does: Fetches sleep from HealthKit for the session's recording window (end = endDate or start + 8 h); on a thrown error logs it as a warning and returns nil.
units.entry: Called from the editor's onRefreshFromHealthKit closure in sleepEditor.

units.does: Fingerprint string: typicalSleepHours, userAge (or -1) and trendKeyPart of every trend session.

One session's key part: its id plus a Hasher digest of every snapshot field the sleep score reads (night, nap, in-bed and awake minutes, efficiency, boundary source, deep/REM minutes, and each stage interval's stage, start and end); the bare id without a snapshot.

Fetches recovery vitals from HealthKit relative to the session end (or start), overrides RHR with the session strap meanHR when present, and stores them in refreshedVitals, or nil when every field is empty so an earlier session's reading is not kept.

branches.effect: refreshedVitals = nil; else the fresh vitals

units.does: Toolbar Menu (ellipsis.circle) holding the Edit sleep button, shown only when there is sleep data and an onAdjust closure to save the edit; nothing otherwise.
'Edit sleep' button that sets editorSleepData to the given sleep data, presenting the editor sheet.
units.entry: Inside menuButton's Menu; tapped by the user.

units.does: Hero card: ScoreRing with metric .sleep (empty state when sleepData nil, else rounded sleepScore with verdict) beside noSleepDataSection.
Hero text: with sleep data shows verdict word, the 24h total sleep (night + nap) and the goal progress bar; without sleep data shows "No sleep data".

branches.effect: verdict word + totalSleepFormatted + goalProgressBar; else "No sleep data" text

units.does: Thin progress bar: (night+nap minutes) / (typicalSleepHours*60), capped at 1.2 for colour and 1.0 for width; green ≥100%, good ≥85%, else caution colour.

branches.effect: wongOptimal when ≥1.0, wongGood when ≥0.85, else wongCaution

units.does: When sleepData exists, shows quickStatCells and latencyHint.
Shows an explanatory caption when the night has no sleep latency.

branches.effect: shows "Latency needs Sleep Schedule wind-down…" caption; else nothing

units.does: Awake stat text: "Not measured" when efficiency is unmeasured (passive HR estimate), else formatted awake minutes.

branches.effect: returns "Not measured"; else hours/minutes of awakeMinutes

units.does: Row of stat tiles: Efficiency, optional Nap, In bed, Awake, Latency.

branches.effect: adds a Nap tile; else omitted
Latency tile shows "—"; else localized minutes

units.does: Shows vitalCells when effectiveVitals exists and is non-empty.
Tiles for Resp (br/min, 1 decimal), SpO2 (%), Temp (deviation via tempDisplay) and Sleep HR (bpm); each "—" when nil.
Formats a wrist-temperature deviation (°C) as signed one-decimal °C or °F (×9/5, no +32 since it is a delta); "—" when nil.
Stat tile: uppercase label above statValue on a card background.
Value text with optional smaller unit text.

branches.effect: appends unit text; else value only

units.does: Formats minutes as localized hours/minutes via LocalizedDuration.hoursMinutes.
Sleep-window card: start–end times, night minutes, and Adjust button, shown only with sleep start and end.

branches.cond: sleepData, sleepStart and sleepEnd all non-nil

units.does: "Adjust" capsule button that sets editorSleepData to open the sleep editor, shown only when onAdjust is set.
Text stack: "Sleep window" heading, "start – end" short times, and night-only sleep duration.
Formats a Date as a short time with a new DateFormatter in the app locale.
ChartCard titled Hypnogram: hypnogramChart when stage intervals exist, else EmptyState "No stage data".
Charts hypnogram of stage bars plus scrub marks with chartXSelection bound to hypnogramScrubbedAt, Y domain 0…4, custom axes, and the scrub pill below.
X axis: hourly grid lines labelled with the hour.
Leading Y axis with marks at 0-3 labelled by stage name.
Axis label text for a numeric stage row.

branches.effect: shows the stage label; else nothing

units.does: One BarMark per stage interval from start to end at the stage's numeric row, coloured by stage.
When scrubbing over an interval, draws a dashed RuleMark at the scrubbed time and a PointMark on that interval's stage row.

branches.cond: scrub date set and an interval covers it
branches.effect: draws rule+point; else no marks (gap or no scrub)

units.does: Capsule pill showing stage colour dot, scrubbed time (hour:minute) and stage name.

branches.cond: scrub date set and an interval covers it

units.does: Linear search for the first interval whose [start, end] contains the date; nil in gaps.
Stage name for the scrub pill: "Asleep" for unspecified stage, else the row label.

branches.effect: returns "Asleep"; else stageLabel of its numeric row

units.does: Maps stage to chart row: awake 3, REM 2, core 1, deep 0, unspecified 1.
Row number to localized stage name (0 Deep, 1 Light, 2 REM, 3 Awake, else empty).
Stage colour: deep primaryDark, core primary, REM wongCaution, awake wongAttention 0.7, unspecified textTertiary.
